entities.summary: Bijon Bhattacharya was an Indian actor from West Bengal associated with Bengali theatre and films. He was an eminent playwright and dramatist. Bijon Bhattacharya was a poets & playwrights from Faridpur District (1917-07-17, Faridpur District–1978-01-19). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
